tirzepatide.name: Tirzepatide (10mg)
tirzepatide.primary_benefits: Unprecedented weight reduction, appetite suppression, enhanced insulin sensitivity, delayed gastric emptying, and sustained glycemic control.
tirzepatide.mechanism: Dual GIP (glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide) and GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1) receptor agonist.

reconstitution.technique: Inject diluent gently along the inside glass wall of the vial. Do not shake vigorously; swirl gently until completely dissolved.
reconstitution.yield_conversion: 2.0mL added to 10mg vial = 5mg per 1.0mL (500mcg per 10 units / 0.1mL on a standard U-100 syringe).

tirzepatide.typical_protocol: Starting research/wellness protocol commonly begins at 2.5mg once weekly for weeks 1-4, titrating to 5.0mg weekly based on response.
tirzepatide.storage: Unreconstituted lyophilized powder: stable at -20°C for 24 months. Reconstituted solution: refrigerate at 2°C - 8°C and use within 30-45 days. Keep shielded from light.

faq.q: How does Tirzepatide differ from Semaglutide?
faq.a: Tirzepatide targets both GIP and GLP-1 receptors simultaneously, resulting in significantly higher mean weight reduction in clinical trials (~20-22% vs ~15% for Semaglutide).

faq.q: Does it need to be refrigerated before reconstitution?
faq.a: For short-term shipping (up to 14 days), the lyophilized powder remains stable at ambient temperatures. Long-term storage should be in a freezer at -20°C.

retatrutide.name: Retatrutide (10mg)
retatrutide.primary_benefits: Triple receptor agonism for maximum fat loss, enhanced basal energy expenditure, fatty liver clearance, and profound appetite regulation.
retatrutide.mechanism: Triple GGG agonist targeting GLP-1, GIP, and Glucagon (GCGR) receptors.

reconstitution.technique: Add 2.0mL bacteriostatic water smoothly down the vial wall. Allow 2-3 minutes for natural dissolution without agitation.
reconstitution.yield_conversion: 2.0mL in 10mg vial = 500mcg per 10 units (0.1mL) on a U-100 insulin syringe.

retatrutide.typical_protocol: Investigational protocols start at 1.0mg - 2.0mg once weekly, gradually stepping up every 4 weeks to 4.0mg - 8.0mg weekly.
retatrutide.storage: Store powder at -20°C. Once reconstituted, refrigerate at 2°C - 8°C; use within 30 days.

faq.a: Its third target—the glucagon receptor—actively ramps up basal metabolic calorie expenditure and hepatic lipid burning, beyond simple appetite suppression.

semaglutide.name: Semaglutide (5mg)
semaglutide.primary_benefits: Proven appetite suppression, food craving reduction, improved HbA1c, and steady fat loss.
semaglutide.mechanism: Selective Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist with albumin-binding fatty acid side chain.

reconstitution.technique: Gently add 2.0mL diluent. Swirl gently until clear.
reconstitution.yield_conversion: 2.0mL in 5mg vial = 250mcg per 10 units (0.1mL) on a standard U-100 syringe.

semaglutide.typical_protocol: Standard ramp starts at 0.25mg once weekly for 4 weeks, increasing to 0.5mg weekly, with a maximum maintenance of 1.7mg - 2.4mg weekly.
semaglutide.storage: Store powder at -20°C. Reconstituted solution must be refrigerated at 2°C - 8°C (stable for 56 days).

faq.q: What is the best time of day to administer?
faq.a: Can be taken at any time of day, with or without food, on the same day each week.

cagrilintide.name: Cagrilintide (5mg)
cagrilintide.primary_benefits: Non-selective amylin receptor agonist that delays gastric transit, triggers early satiety signals in the brainstem, and prevents weight regain.
cagrilintide.mechanism: Long-acting amylin analogue activating AMY1, AMY2, AMY3, and calcitonin receptors.

reconstitution.technique: Slowly introduce 2.0mL BAC water. Invert gently twice.

cagrilintide.typical_protocol: Frequently researched in tandem with Semaglutide (CagriSema stack) at 0.25mg to 2.4mg weekly.
cagrilintide.storage: Store dry powder at -20°C; reconstituted at 2°C - 8°C.

faq.q: Can Cagrilintide be mixed in the same syringe as Semaglutide?
faq.a: They should be reconstituted in separate vials; researchers often co-administer simultaneously at different injection sites.

bpc157.name: BPC-157 (5mg)
bpc157.primary_benefits: Accelerated tendon, ligament, and muscle healing, gut lining repair (leaky gut, IBD), angiogenesis (blood vessel recruitment), and joint mobility.
bpc157.mechanism: Body Protection Compound pentadecapeptide that stimulates VEGF expression, FAK/paxillin signaling, and nitric oxide synthesis.

reconstitution.technique: Add 2.5mL for standard dosing. Yields 200mcg per 10 units (0.1mL).

bpc157.typical_protocol: 250mcg to 500mcg administered once or twice daily for 4 to 8 weeks.
bpc157.storage: Store at -20°C. Reconstituted: refrigerate at 2°C - 8°C and use within 28 days.

faq.q: Does BPC-157 need to be injected near the injury?
faq.a: BPC-157 exhibits strong systemic bioavailability whether injected subcutaneously in the abdomen or closer to an injured tendon.

tb500.name: TB-500 (5mg)
tb500.primary_benefits: Systemic cellular migration, flexibility and range of motion improvement, anti-fibrotic remodeling, and heart/muscle recovery.
tb500.mechanism: Synthetic active domain of Thymosin Beta-4, a major G-actin sequestering peptide promoting rapid microvascular recruitment.
tb500.typical_protocol: Loading protocol: 2.0mg to 2.5mg twice weekly for 4 to 6 weeks, followed by maintenance at 2.0mg every 2 weeks.

faq.q: Why is TB-500 frequently paired with BPC-157?
faq.a: They act via complementary mechanisms: BPC-157 creates new blood vessels (angiogenesis) and repairs soft tissue, while TB-500 migrates actin to rebuild cellular infrastructure.

ghkcu.name: GHK-Cu Copper Peptide (50mg)
ghkcu.primary_benefits: Collagen type I & III synthesis, skin tightening and wrinkle reduction, scalp hair follicle stimulation, anti-inflammatory, and DNA repair gene activation.
ghkcu.mechanism: Naturally occurring copper tripeptide (Gly-His-Lys:Cu2+) regulating over 4,000 human genes associated with dermal remodeling and repair.

reconstitution.technique: Dissolves rapidly into an intense royal blue solution upon contact with water.

ghkcu.typical_protocol: Subcutaneous: 1.0mg to 2.0mg daily for 30-day cycles. Topical: formulated at 1-3% in facial serums or hair sprays.
ghkcu.half_life: ~1-2 hours in plasma; long-lasting tissue gene-expression effect.
ghkcu.storage: Store dry powder at -20°C. Protect from intense direct sunlight.

faq.a: GHK naturally binds copper (Cu2+) ions, creating an intense azure-blue hue that confirms authentic high-purity chelation.

epithalon.name: Epithalon (10mg)
epithalon.primary_benefits: Telomerase enzyme activation, telomere elongation, biological age reduction, pineal gland restoration, circadian rhythm alignment, and deep sleep.
epithalon.mechanism: Synthetic biomimetic tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) modeled on bovine epithalamin.
epithalon.typical_protocol: Classic Khavinson protocol: 5mg to 10mg daily for 10 to 20 consecutive days, repeated once or twice yearly.
epithalon.half_life: Rapid systemic uptake; activates downstream telomerase gene transcription.
epithalon.storage: Store at -20°C. Reconstituted: refrigerate and use within 20 days.

faq.q: How often is an Epithalon cycle conducted?
faq.a: Typically conducted as a 10-day intensive cycle every 6 to 12 months for longevity and cellular age reset.

motsc.name: MOTS-c (10mg)
motsc.primary_benefits: Mitochondrial energy enhancement, exercise mimetic effects, glucose disposal, AMPK activation, metabolic flexibility, and physical endurance.
motsc.mechanism: Mitochondrial-derived 16-amino acid peptide that acts as an endocrine signal promoting metabolic homeostasis.

reconstitution.technique: Add 2.0mL BAC water down vial wall.

motsc.typical_protocol: 5mg to 10mg administered 1 to 3 times weekly, often before exercise sessions, for 4 to 8 weeks.
motsc.storage: Store at -20°C. Reconstituted: keep at 2°C - 8°C; use within 21 days.

faq.q: When is the best time to administer MOTS-c?
faq.a: Most researchers administer MOTS-c in the morning or 1-2 hours prior to physical training sessions to optimize mitochondrial ATP production.

cjcipam.name: CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin (10mg)
cjcipam.primary_benefits: Pulsatile natural growth hormone elevation, deep slow-wave stage-4 sleep, lean muscle preservation, accelerated recovery, and body fat reduction.
cjcipam.mechanism: Synergistic GHRH (Growth Hormone Releasing Hormone) analog + selective Ghrelin receptor agonist.

reconstitution.yield_conversion: 2.0mL in 10mg vial = 250mcg CJC / 250mcg Ipamorelin per 10 units.

cjcipam.typical_protocol: 100mcg to 300mcg administered nightly immediately before sleep on an empty stomach.
cjcipam.half_life: Ipamorelin ~2 hours; CJC-1295 (no DAC) ~30 mins. Produces clean natural GH surge.
cjcipam.storage: Store at -20°C. Reconstituted: refrigerate at 2°C - 8°C; use within 30 days.

faq.a: Human growth hormone naturally pulses during early deep sleep. Taking this blend before sleep amplifies your natural physiological peak without desensitizing pituitary receptors.

aod9604.name: AOD-9604 (5mg)

storage.lyophilized: Stable at -20°C for 24 months; 2-8°C for 12 months

aod9604.appearance: White to off-white lyophilized powder or cake
aod9604.solubility: Freely soluble in bacteriostatic water; soluble in 0.1% TFA/water
aod9604.purity_method: RP-HPLC (C18 column, 214nm UV), confirmed by LC-MS/MS

faq.a: AOD-9604 is a modified 16-amino acid fragment of human growth hormone (hGH 176-191) that has been investigated for its lipolytic (fat-metabolizing) properties without the growth-promoting or diabetogenic effects of full-length hGH.
Store lyophilized vial at -20°C or 2-8°C. After reconstitution with bacteriostatic water, refrigerate at 2-8°C and use within 28 days.

faq.q: How long can I store MK-677?
faq.a: Capsules are stable at room temperature for up to 24 months. Keep the bottle tightly sealed away from moisture and direct sunlight.

tesamorelin.name: Tesamorelin (10mg)

reconstitution.notes: Add solvent slowly against vial wall. Gently swirl — do not shake or vortex.

tesamorelin.solubility: Freely soluble in bacteriostatic water and sterile water
tesamorelin.purity_method: RP-HPLC (≥99.2%), ESI-MS molecular weight confirmation, endotoxin <1.0 EU/mg

Add 5.0 mL of bacteriostatic water to the 10mg vial for a 2.0 mg/mL concentration. Inject slowly against the glass wall and gently swirl until dissolved.

semax.name: Semax Nasal Spray (30mg / 10mL)

administration.notes: Prime pump with 3-4 actuations before first use. Store upright.

storage.after_opening: 2-8°C; use within 30 days of first actuation

semax.half_life: ~30 seconds intranasal (rapid CNS absorption via olfactory mucosa)
semax.appearance: Clear, colorless to slightly yellow aqueous solution
semax.purity_method: RP-HPLC (≥99.4%), LC-MS confirmation, sterility testing, endotoxin <0.25 EU/mL

faq.a: Semax is a synthetic heptapeptide analog of ACTH(4-10) developed in Russia for neuroprotective and nootropic applications. It upregulates BDNF and modulates dopaminergic and serotonergic systems.

faq.q: How do I use the nasal spray?
faq.a: Prime the pump 3-4 times before first use. Insert nozzle into nostril and press firmly for one actuation (~100 mcg). Alternate nostrils with each spray.
Yes. Keep refrigerated at 2-8°C both before and after opening. Use within 30 days of first actuation.

selank.name: Selank Nasal Spray (10mg / 10mL)

administration.notes: Prime pump before first use. Tilt head slightly forward during administration.

selank.half_life: ~2-3 minutes (rapid enzymatic degradation; functional effects last several hours via downstream GABA modulation)
selank.purity_method: RP-HPLC (≥99.2%), LC-MS confirmation, sterility and endotoxin testing

faq.a: Selank is a synthetic analog of the naturally occurring immunomodulatory peptide tuftsin, with an added Pro-Gly-Pro tail for enhanced stability. Investigated for anxiolytic effects, GABA modulation, and cognitive performance under stress.

faq.q: How does Selank differ from Semax?
faq.a: Semax is an ACTH(4-10) analog that primarily targets BDNF and dopaminergic pathways (focus/cognition). Selank is a tuftsin analog that primarily modulates GABAergic transmission (anxiolysis/calm). They are often studied together as complementary compounds.

faq.q: Can I combine Selank with Semax?
faq.a: They are frequently investigated together in nootropic research protocols. Selank (calming, anxiolytic) + Semax (focus, BDNF) target complementary neurotransmitter systems.

pt141.name: PT-141 Bremelanotide (10mg)

pt141.solubility: Freely soluble in bacteriostatic water and sterile water for injection
pt141.purity_method: RP-HPLC (≥99.3%), LC-MS molecular weight confirmation, endotoxin <0.5 EU/mg

faq.a: PT-141 is a cyclic heptapeptide melanocortin receptor agonist (MC3R/MC4R). FDA-approved as Vyleesi® for hypoactive sexual desire disorder (HSDD) in premenopausal women. It acts centrally in the hypothalamus, unlike PDE5 inhibitors which act peripherally.

faq.q: How often can PT-141 be used?
faq.a: Not more than once within 24 hours, and no more than 8 doses per month per FDA labeling. Nausea is the most commonly reported side effect.
